text: Thanks for reaching out, we are looking into it.
My package is late and still says in transit.
We can look into this. Please share the tracking number.
I was charged twice for the same order and need a refund.
We can review the duplicate charge and issue a refund if eligible.
I cannot log in to my account, my password reset doesn't work.
We can reset the account and help recover access.
My item arrived damaged and I need a replacement.
We are sorry and can help with a replacement or refund.
Someone used my account without permission. This is a fraud issue.
We take this seriously and will escalate this to our security team.
Your service is terrible and I am very disappointed.
We are sorry for the frustration and appreciate the feedback.
Thanks for the quick help, I love the product.
Thank you for the kind words. We are glad we could help.
